data.name: Ridfan
data.gender_notes: Ridfan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who loves gardens and rain. The name Ridfan carries the meaning “Lover of the Garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Ridfan usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of the garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to those who appreciate the beauty of nature and seek peace and tranquility
data.etymology: Ridfan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover of the Garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ridfan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: رضفان
in_arabic.meaning: رضفان يعني الشخص الذي يحميه الله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رضفان مشتق من الجذر العربي رضف، ويعني الشخص الذي يحميه الله تعالى، ويحفظه من كل سوء، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان آية 57: 'وَيَحفِظُكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَكۜرٍ وَيُضِلُّ عَنكُم مِّن كُلِّ بَغيٍ مُّبِينٍ'. اسم رضفان يدل على معاني الحماية والرعاية الإلهية.

in_urdu.name: رضفان
in_urdu.meaning: رضفان کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جس کی حفاظت اللہ تعالیٰ کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رضفان نام عربی جڑ رضف سے نکلا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جس کی حفاظت اللہ تعالیٰ کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے اور اسلامی روایت میں اس کی روحانی اہمیت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रिदफान
in_hindi.meaning: रिदफान का अर्थ है अल्लाह द्वारा संरक्षित व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: रिदफान नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल رضف से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है अल्लाह द्वारा संरक्षित व्यक्ति। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग होता है और इसकी आध्यात्मिक महत्ता है।

in_pashto.name: رضفان
in_pashto.meaning: رضفان د هغه چا معنی چې الله تعالی یې ساتي
in_pashto.long_meaning: رضفان نوم د عربي ريښې رضف څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د الله تعالی لخوا ساتل شوي کس معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او د پښتنو په اسلامي روایت کې یې روحاني ارزښت دی.

in_english.name: Ridfan
in_english.meaning: Ridfan means a person protected or preserved by Allah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ridfan originates from the Arabic root رضف (ridfan), meaning a person protected or preserved by Allah. Referenced in Quranic verses emphasizing divine protection, Ridfan signifies spiritual safeguarding. Historically used in Islamic tradition, Ridfan connotes piety and divine care.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ridwan is derived from the Arabic words "Ridh" meaning pleasure and "Wan" meaning rain. In Islamic culture, gardens symbolize tranquility, serenity, and paradise. The name Ridwan signifies the beauty and peace associated with nature. In some communities, it is believed that the name Ridwan is good luck as it resembles the Arabic word "Ridhwaan" meaning contentment and approval from Allah.

It is believed that one who carries the name Ridwan is reminded to strive for spiritual growth and to seek Allah's pleasure and approval in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Lover of the Garden" symbolizes One who loves gardens and rain. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ridfan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of lover of the garden.

historical_references.reference: Ridwan was the name of a Persian vizier who served under the Buyid dynasty. He was known for his wisdom, piety, and justice, and is revered in Shia Islam as a role model for good governance.
historical_references.context: The Buyid dynasty was a Muslim dynasty that ruled parts of Iran and Iraq from the 10th to the 12th centuries CE. Ridwan's service under this dynasty and his reputation for wisdom, piety, and justice made him a revered figure in Shia Islam.

historical_references.reference: Ridwan is mentioned in the Quran as the name of an angel who will receive the righteous in paradise. In Islamic tradition, Ridwan is believed to be the guardian of the gates of paradise and to bestow blessings upon those who enter.
historical_references.context: The Quran is the holy book of Islam, revealing the words of God as spoken to the Prophet Muhammad. The mention of Ridwan in the Quran has given him a significant role in Islamic belief and tradition.
